question: Who was the music director of the film Bees Saal Baad, which was released in 1962?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hemant Kumar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hemant Kumar** was the music director of the film **Bees Saal Baad**, which was released in 1962.
 
• Hemant Kumar was a renowned playback singer and music director in Indian cinema.
 
• He is known for his melodious compositions and has contributed significantly to Hindi and Bengali music.
 
• The soundtrack of **Bees Saal Baad** is still remembered for its haunting melodies and classical compositions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bees Saal Baad** is a Hindi-language thriller film directed by Biren Nag.
 
• The film was a major success at the box office and is considered a classic in Indian cinema.
 
• The movie is based on Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's novel "The Hound of the Baskervilles."
 
• Hemant Kumar also sang some of the songs in the movie, adding to its musical appeal.
